reviews.text: Because I am a foreigner, the staff member who answered the phone ignored me. I was told that if I gave them my phone number, a doctor would call me back, but they never did. My Japanese is not so bad that they couldn't understand me, so I explained that my cat had terminal leukemia and needed to be euthanized. I explained the situation clearly, but the staff member continued to pretend to be kind.
Thank you for your 5-star rating. All of our staff will continue to strive to provide you with satisfactory medical care. Please come again.

I was receiving palliative care for my cat with terminal cancer, and I inquired about whether they would give me an anti-nausea injection, but I never received a reply. I was desperate and saddened by the wait.
